conventions.claim_types: legal-entity taxonomy per backend/contracts.py ClaimType (amended 2026-08-29); claim_types_legal_map.json is the definition doc, kept 1:1
conventions.cross_product_expansion: RulebookEntry.product is single-valued; cross-product rules are expanded per product with rule_id family prefix XP-<FAMILY>-<NNN>-<product>
conventions.data_refs: bulky data lives in data/*.json; rules reference it via '@<file>.<key>' strings (validated)
conventions.versioning: rulebook_version = YYYY.MM.patch; bump patch for rule edits, month for additions; CheckRun.rulebook_version records what each run executed against
